To disable the dual-screen presenter view in LibreOffice Impress and use only one monitor for presentations, follow these steps:

1. Open LibreOffice Impress
2. Click on **Tools** in the top menu bar
3. Select **Options...** from the dropdown menu
4. In the Options dialog, navigate to **LibreOffice Impress > General** in the left tree view
5. In the Presentation section on the right, uncheck the **Enable Presenter Console** checkbox
6. Click **OK** to save the changes

This configuration change ensures that when you start a presentation, it will display on only one monitor without the presenter console (which shows current slide, next slide, and notes on a separate screen). The second monitor will then be free for other purposes during your presentation.

The setting has been successfully applied and saved.
